agenda_text:

  the agenda listed below:

  La Cienega Park & Community Center
  Auditorium
  8400 Gregory Way
  Beverly Hills, CA 90211

  Thursday, January 31, 2019
  3:30 PM

  AGENDA

  i. 8484 Wilshire Blvd.
  ii. 8440 Wilshire Blvd.
  iii. 8383 Wilshire Blvd.
  iv. 100 La Cienega Blvd.
  v. 8634 Wilshire Blvd.

minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  La Cienega Park Community Center Auditorium
  8400 Gregory Way
  Beverly Hills CA, 90210

  Strategic Planning Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, January 31, 2019
  3:30 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  January 31, 2019 / 3:30pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold MD, Vice Mayor John Mirisch, City Treasurer
  Howard Fisher, Facilitator Karen Orlansky, City Manager Mahdi
  Aluzri, Honorable Kathy Reims, Health & Safety Commissioner
  Myra Lurie, Health & Safety Commissioner Daniel Nazarian,
  Cultural Heritage Commissioner Noah Furie, Human Relations
  Commissioner Ori Blumenfield, Mark Elliott, Sharon Ignarro
  Director of Community Development Susan Healy Keene, Director
  of Public Works Shana Epstein, Assistant Director of Community
  Services Pamela Shinault, Deputy Director of Transportation Aaron
  Kunz, Assistant Director of Community Development Ryan Gohlich,
  Marketing and Economic Sustainability Manager Laura Biery,
  Policy and Management Analyst Cindy Owens, Senior Planner
  Timmi Tway, Management Analyst Teresa Revis, Transportation
  Planner Jessie Holzer

  1.  Public Comment
   Members of the public asked if there is a plan for the La Cienega/Wilshire
  area when it becomes a “transit zone”

  2. Walking Tour of La Cienega/Wilshire Focus Area
   The Committee participated in a walking tour of the La Cienega/Wilshire.
  Brief stops occurred outside the following locations:
   8484 Wilshire Blvd.
   8440 Wilshire Blvd.
   100 La Cienega Blvd.

  3. Return to Auditorium for Discussion Regarding Walking Tour Observations
   Committee Members shared feedback on the area;
   Area has numerous challenges; however it is a great area for
  opportunity.
   Steps that could be taken to best revitalize the area
   The possibility of mixed use
   How to bring more businesses into that area
   Will require feedback from residents about their needs and wants for that
  area prior to making a decision.
 4. Confirm Future Meeting Dates
   Next meeting scheduled for February 7, 2019

5. Adjourn
  Date / Time  January 31, 2019 / 5:00pm
